related_questions.question: How does land tax work in Scotland?
related_questions.snippet: You have to pay Land and Buildings Transaction Tax (LBTT) if you buy property or land in Scotland above a certain value. Most people will know it as the tax they may pay when buying a house, but it also applies to non-residential purchases and leases. LBTT is the Scottish equivalent of Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT).
